Gujarat and Maharashtra lead in attracting investors, according to NITI index

The NITI Aayog has released an investment friendliness index that ranks states based on various factors such as infrastructure, business climate, and government policy. Gujarat and Maharashtra have topped the list, followed by Tamil Nadu. The index aims to promote economic growth and development in India.
